resolutions.resolution: Read as ramp: the row's own Notes state 'ramp up/down vbus from 3~5V' and HELPER says 'ramp VBUS'; the two 1e-3 entries form a same-Pin same-status run (vbus 5 then 3), which the output contract's rampFrom clause explicitly covers; additionally the workbook's own codeExplain glossary names the vset third argument 'rampTime', so a 1e-3 pulse time is a 1 ms ramp time.
